slug: 2026-03-31 Africa we have a data problem

facts.fact: The Data Landscapers 54-country review states that rural primary clinics (CSPS) record on paper, health workers summarise indicators on paper forms monthly and districts enter them into the national DHIS2/Endos system, digital entry occurring at district level; it cites a BMJ Global Health study and gives no date, so the publication date is used.

The Data Landscapers review states that EMRs in Burkina Faso are limited to pilots or incomplete and are absent at primary level, citing a 2024 BMC study; it gives no date, so the publication date is used.

systems.tiers: entered at district level from CSPS paper forms
more than 1,600 CSPS in select districts (556 by 2022), maternal and child consultations, parallel to paper and not integrated

note: The file's own header marks the country figures as an AI-aided compilation and the author's analysis; the review also states 35+ digital health interventions, 66% of them pilots.
